note: Generated by write_period_null_table (longterm/null_tests.rs), fixed seeds. 400 draws a cell for the mean and as many for the maximum. The maximum's generalised extreme value by maximum likelihood: location and scale for each cell (the scale's relative error about 4%); the shape profiled over 0 to 0.3 in steps of 0.02, shared by each take length and step (readings) or each mix (timing). Timing's location and scale are fitted to the maxima grouped by the mix each take's search fitted, which is the coordinate the lookup reads, pooled from every drawn mix of that length and step. The drawn mixes are white, 1 to 10^4 up to 0.35 of the sampling rate, and walk. The drawn mixes reach both ends of the lookup's axis, white and walk, so no fitted mix lies past them. A cell that fewer than 200 draws read takes the 200 read nearest it. Each cell's tail is then the least favourable over the drawn mixes read as it or either neighbour (the lookup blends neighbours): fitted to the drawn mix, of those giving at least 50 draws, whose maxima most often pass the fit's p 0.001 and 0.0003 levels, refitted until that mix is the one fitted, and sharing that mix's shape group. So the false-alarm chance holds for every drawn mix, not on average over them. Each bin's whitened power is scored by its own null spread (a gamma shape per x). Pooled tail check: 1573 of 160701 null maxima under p 0.01 (expected 1607), 232 under 0.001 (expected 161).
